title: the file's claim and nothing else
line: the claimed-relationship route takes a person the file itself claims, and nothing else stands in for the file: the parents an obituary names are taken on the file's own claim of them, while the sister it names, created by the rule and placed beside her brother from that very notice, is never taken on that placement once her creation is taken back on a superseded reading: the rule takes her card as the creation it stands for, on the creation's own terms

steps.say: the owner's word on his parents: the file's own claim of them accepted, so he is an accepted child of the couple
his obituary, the file's own citation, archived and read
the owner accepts him on it: the rule takes his parents through the link the file claims, and creates the sister the notice names, placing her beside him

expect.why: the mother holds no accepted name yet: the notice states her his mother, he is accepted on it, and the file itself claims the link, so the route takes her
a sister the notice states, whom nobody in the tree fits: created by the rule

steps.say: the notice read again while the creation stands: her link carries to the new reading
the rule takes the creation back: its card undecided again on the superseded reading, the person and the placement written from this notice staying
the record's open cards marked as an older matcher's

reconsider closes the card on the superseded reading and puts the current reading's persona to the person the creation made: the placement from this very notice is no claim of the file's, and the rule takes the card as the creation it stands for
